general_information.Description: The course is designed to develop and sharpen learners' academic and professional writing skills and strategies in English. Each unit guides the student through the structured writing process with plenty of full colour illustrations, examples, and exercises to engage the student and build confidence. This course aims at providing students understanding and skills from writing sentences to a full paragraph.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance - Access the course website (www.cms.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Demonstrate the ability to write main idea sentences and supporting detailed sentences
Know how to describe places and personal items with correct sentence structure and vocabulary

assessments.CLO: LO1, LO2, LO3, LO4, LO5, LO6
assessments.No Question: Write a parapraph based on the contents covered Length: ~150 words Time: 20'
assessments.Knowledge and Skill: Test the acquainted knowledge which student obtained in the delivered units. Content based on topics of studied units
assessments.Note: Teacher is allowed to select which unit content (topic or learning outcome) to focus on each examination session.
Teachers give topics, start and finish time for each Project/Assignment by themself.
